tools.name: calculate_korea_import_customs
tools.description: Calculates South Korean import customs duty, VAT, special consumption tax, de-minimis exemptions ($200 US KORUS FTA / $150 global), and total landed KRW cost across USD, JPY, EUR, and CNY.

tools.name: compare_crossborder_payout_fees
tools.description: Compares net USD and KRW settlement proceeds across L2 USDC on-chain rails, mid-market fintech FX transfers, SWIFT bank wires, and commercial PayPal invoices.

tools.name: batch_audit_korea_import_skus_x402
tools.description: Computes landed KRW customs duty, VAT, FTA exemptions, and domestic break-even across up to 15 SKUs in parallel. $0.006 a call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base eip155:8453).
